rationale: The claim is a valid equivalence between fixed-marginal separability and channel entanglement-breaking via the Jamiołkowski isomorphism. None of the supplied meta-candidates establishes or directly supports this isomorphism-based equivalence: no-broadcasting, Church-Turing, monogamy, renormalization, Cook-Levin, perfectoid tilting, fixed points, Rice, Markov equivalence, and CAP are all in different problem domains or address different properties. The claim is solid but has no compatible root in the candidate list.
